python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p='/private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-guillaumeloulier-PhpstormProjects-oss-elephc--claude-worktrees-streams-csv-signature/c8dbe38f-1f79-484f-9b83-62bacab9ca56/scratchpad/add_fparam_test.py'
s=open(p).read()
start=s.index('    assert_eq!(\n        out,\n        concat!(')
end=s.index('    let _ = fs::remove_dir_all(&dir);')
good = '''    assert_eq!(
        out,
        concat!(
            // "aGVsbG8g" CRLF "d29ybGQ=" — the default break is CRLF, not a lone newline
            "61475673624738670d0a643239796247513d\\n",
            "aGVsbG8g|d29ybGQ=\\n",
            "aGVsbG8gd29ybGQ=\\n",
            "a=20b=09c\\n",
            "a b\\tc\\n",
            // 11 a's, the soft `=` that costs a column of its own, CRLF, then the remaining 9
            "616161616161616161616161 3d0d0a616161616161616161\\n",
            // the escape FITS at column 6 with line-length 10, so no break precedes it
            "6161616161613d45393d0d0a626262626262\\n",
            // at line-length 8 it does not, so the break comes first and the triplet stays whole
            "61616161616161613d0d0a3d45396262623d0d0a626262\\n",
        )
    );
'''
s = s[:start] + good + s[end:]
# the sixth line still carries a stray space from the draft
s = s.replace('"616161616161616161616161 3d0d0a616161616161616161\\n"', '"6161616161616161616161613d0d0a616161616161616161\\n"')
open(p,'w').write(s)
print('expectation cleaned')
